table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale'   else item.name end, 
	users.username, 
	reprintdate=getdate(), 
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,
	posted=max(saleledger.posted),
	balance=isnull(max(balance),0),
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.date,
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	dbo.saleledger.custcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,   
	dbo.saledetail.icode,   
	dbo.saledetail.gcode, 
	Id        = MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),  
	looseqty  = sum(saledetail.looseqty), 
	packqty   = sum(saledetail.packqty), 
	packunits = max(saledetail.packunits), 
	saleprice = max(saledetail.saleprice), 
	rate      = max(saledetail.rate),
	salestax  = max(saledetail.salestax),   
	discperc  = max(saledetail.discperc), 
	customername='                                  '  ,
	itemflatdisc  = max(saledetail.itemflatdisc),
	unitsalestax  = max(saledetail.unitsalestax),
	gstperc       = max(saledetail.gstperc),
	invgstperc    = max(saleledger.invgstperc1),
	reprintcounter=max(saleledger.reprintingcounter),
	doctor=max(doctors.name),
	patient=max(patient.name),
	serverdate=getdate()
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger
	LEFT OUTER JOIN Doctors ON (saleledger.doctcode=doctors.doctcode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN Patient ON (saleledger.patientcode=patient.patientcode),
	dbo.saledetail,  
	item,
	Users
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode IN (:ar_docrowid) ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) AND 
	( saleLedger.SalesManCode = users.userCode ) and
	( saledetail.icode = item.icode )
GROUP BY 
	saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	saleledger.date, 
	saleledger.custcode, 
	saleledger.discperc, 
	saleledger.flatdisc, 
	saleledger.misccharges, 
	saleledger.headerno,
	saleledger.salestax, 
	saleledger.remarks, 
	saledetail.icode, 
	saledetail.rowgroup,
	saledetail.gcode, 
	item.name,
	item.icode,
	item.printable,
	users.username
ORDER BY 
	saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL)

objects.name: c_totalsalestax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - saleledger_discperc * 0.01) ,2) -  saleledger_flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for group 1) , 0)

objects.name: compute_6
objects.expression: sum( looseqty *  (saledetail_saleprice - itemflatdisc)  *  saledetail_discperc  * .01 for group 1)

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - saleledger_discperc * 0.01),2) -  saleledger_flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_sumitemleveltaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round(looseqty * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1) -  saleledger_flatdisc  +  saleledger_misccharges  + saleledger_salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - saleledger_discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  saleledger_flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)
